contexts.text: The first state (of regeneration) is that which precedes...
They are among those who want to be first, but become last ().
Thus the first state and the last are united.
All things regard Him as the First ex quo, and as the Last ad quem.
There, truth is in the first place... but here, good is in the first place...
Truth no longer put in the first place.
Under Connect, see this reference. AC 3739:2. AC 5413:end. HH 9. HH 303. HH 303:2. AE 349:5.
Nothing can subsist from itself, but something else... and finally from the First... The Lord is the First. AC 4523:3. AC 6040. AC 9128:3. HH 9. HH 106:end.
Under Boundary, see this reference.
He had believed that he would be among the first in Heaven.
Three = the last and the first together...
As the last is thus continued into the first, it is said that He is the Last and the First.
Truth is apparently in the first place... while man is being regenerated; but good is manifestly in the first place when man is regenerate. References.
This state is the first, and is called the state of reformation.
In the first times, when man is being regenerated...
The first and last must join together for there to be conjunction; the first must be the good a quo, and the last the good ad quod.
Under End, see this reference. AC 6936:end. CanonsNC 10. God. 7. 3. 5.
When they first arrive there...
The falsified truths which are in the first place. Signified.
The first, when said of the months signifies the beginning. AC 7887. AC 7891. AC 7900.
The things which are first signify the rest in order.
(Thus) the first is everything in the products and derivatives, insomuch that if the first is removed, its successives perish. The Divine is the first of all things. AE 725:4. AE 866:2.

As the first and the last = each and all things, or the whole with its parts, the omnipotence and omniscience of the Lord are described by His being the First and the Last... Illustrated. AC 10329:end. HH 304.
To confer on him all things of Divine order, from primes to ultimates. Signified.
Thus God became man, as in primes, so in ultimates. Explained.
Hence the Lord is called the First and the Last... DSS 98:end. DP 124:end. TCR 84:end.

In every Divine work there is a first, a middle, and an ultimate; and the first goes through the middle to the ultimate, and thus comes into existence and subsists. Also, the first is in the middle, and, through the middle, in the ultimate. Explained. DSS 38:2.
Before (His advent) the Lord was indeed the Word, but in primes. Signified.
Primes are each and all things of the animal kingdom... man being the first in order.
Every ultimate consists of prior things, and these of their primes.
He is Divine love and wisdom itself, in both primes and ultimates.
There is a connection (of the greatest and least things) from primes to ultimates. Explained.

There are perpetual mediations from the First to ultimates; and nothing can come into existence except from what is prior to itself, and at last from the First. The First is the Sun of the Spiritual World; and the First of that Sun is... the Lord.
As there is such a progression of the fibres and vessels from primes to ultimates, there is a like progression of their states...
Progression from primes to ultimates, and from ultimates to primes... DLW 314. DLW 314. DLW 316. DLW 316:2. DLW 316:3. Explained.
Therefore all the Lord's operation is from primes and ultimates together.
All reformation takes place in fulness, that is, in primes and in ultimates together, and the ultimates are reformed in the world so as to agree with the primes...
What is first in time, and what is first in end. Explained.
Who rules all things from primes through ultimates. Signified. AE 66.
The Divine love of the Divine wisdom in primes and in ultimates. Signified.
The First and the Last () = the Lord, that He is the only God. ( = the Lord, who, from His Divine Human, rules all things from primes through ultimates. AE 113.) AE 41. AE 81.
The tribe mentioned in the first place is the all in the rest.
From primes to ultimates. CL 293:4.

All order proceeds from primes to ultimates, and the ultimates become the primes of some following order; moreover, all things of the middle order are the ultimates of the prior and the primes of the following one. (Therefore) such as is the order of this love from its first heat to its first torch, such it is... in its progression...
That God is omnipresent from the primes to the ultimates of His order.

Faith (or) truth is the first in time; but charity (or) good is the first in end; and that which is the first in end is actually the first, because it is primary, and thus the first-born; whereas that which is first in time is not actually the first, but apparently. (Explained by comparisons.)
On those who want to be the first in whatever they do.
That the Lord has led mankind ever since the creation of the first man.
How could the first man have come into existence before the Grand Man was formed? The first man, and those who were born first, were led by the Lord alone.
The direction of the Lord is in primes and in ultimates; from this mediates flow in their order. Ultimates are as much directed as primes.

In the Word it is usual to mention those things in the first place which take place in the last, because the intermediate things are included in them; for, in the spiritual sense, the first is the end propter quem, because the end is the first and the last...
From these, as from their primes or beginnings, all the rest flow.
For the Divine operates from primes through ultimates... AE 806:3.
That thus He might rule and dispose ultimates from primes, and all intermediates from primes through ultimates...
That... hence the Lord has infinite power from primes through ultimates... Primes are those things which are in the Lord, and which proximately proceed from Him.
See First-fruits.
The ten commandments were the first of the Word. Explained.
The Lord does not operate from primes through mediates into ultimates, but from primes through ultimates, and thus into mediates; hence He is called the First and the Last. 1087[3].
This the Lord could do from the Divine in Himself, which was in primes, through His Human, which was in ultimates.
(Thus) everything comes forth, subsists, acts, and is moved from the First which is not from another...
The force of creating... proceeds from the First through intermediates to the ultimate; the First is the Sun of Heaven...
The universe was so created by Him that He is in primes and in ultimates. Explained.
All Divine operation passes through the whole of order, from primes to ultimates.
He became the Last, that so the First might act through ultimates... that is, from primes through ultimates; for when He acted from primes through ultimates, He acted through all things...
Of the Divine from which is the universe, an idea is to be perceived no otherwise than as of a Divine Man in first principles...
The Divine which proceeds from the Lord is Divine from primes down to ultimates; the ultimates are what are called bones...
From the primes of uses to their ultimates...
In its primes it is in the brains; these primes (are) the cortical and cineritious substances.
He has prepared for Himself all mediates, from primes down to ultimates...
Thus life comes into full effect from primes to ultimates.
3. All Divine influx is from primes into ultimates, and, through connection with ultimates, into mediates... Therefore He is called the First and the Last.
God 8. 12. God acts from primes through ultimates, and thus keeps all things together.
Redemption. 8. 10. All the operation of God takes place from primes through ultimates, thus from His Divine through His Human. Hence it is that God is the First and the Last...
A primus infulatus = a first-born.
